definitions.explanation: The quick closing and opening of the eyelids, either voluntarily or as a natural reflex.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{瞬|まばた}きもせずに{画面|がめん}を{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: She was looking at the screen without blinking.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}は{一日|いちにち}に{何千回|なんぜんかい}も{瞬|まばた}きをする。
examples.english: Humans blink thousands of times a day.

examples.japanese: {瞬|まばた}きする{間|あいだ}もなく、{事故|じこ}が{起|お}こった。
examples.english: The accident happened in the blink of an eye.

examples.japanese: コンタクトレンズをしていると{瞬|まばた}きの{回数|かいすう}が{減|へ}る。
examples.english: Wearing contact lenses reduces the frequency of blinking.

notes:
KANJI: Can also be written as {瞬き|まばたき}. The verb form is {瞬|まばた}く.

VERB FORMS:
・{瞬|まばた}きをする (to blink - suru-verb form)
・{瞬|まばた}く (to blink - standalone verb)

IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS:
・{瞬|まばた}きもしない - without blinking (intense focus/stare)
・{瞬|まばた}きする{間|あいだ}もなく - in the blink of an eye, instantly
・{瞬|まばた}きひとつしない - not even a single blink (showing no emotion)

RELATED EYE ACTIONS:
・ウインク - wink (intentional, single eye)
・{目|め}をつぶる - to close one's eyes
・{目|め}を{見開|みひら}く - to open one's eyes wide
